newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Prominent leftist gunned down in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Prominent leftist gunned down in Colombia.

text.p: A human rights lawyer and leader of the leftist Patriotic Union Party in Colombia's violence-torn Meta province was shot and killed by a lone gunman outside his home in the provincial capital of Villavicencio, authorities said on Monday.

Police quoted witnesses as saying Josue Giraldo Cardona, 38, was erecting a tent for his two young daughters just outside his house early on Sunday when his pistol-wielding assassin sauntered up to him and opened fire without warning.

Cardona tried to run for the safety of his house but was felled by a shot in the back and finished off with another six or seven rounds that the gunman pumped into him at point-blank range, police said. They said the gunman, who was not identified, fled on a late-model blue Yamaha motorcyle driven by an accomplice.

Cardona, a lawyer who newspaper accounts said had been the target of several assassination attempts in the past, was president of the independent Meta Human Rights Committee. His Patriotic Union Party has been described as the political arm of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest and oldest leftist guerrilla group.
Thousands of members of the party have been gunned down by right-wing gunmen since 1985 and much of the carnage has centred on Meta, long considered a FARC stronghold.
